items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-03
items.q: Who was a trombone player? Oak Gasper. Not Oak. No, Oak's brother. What's his name? Victor. Yeah, Vic Gasper.

ctx.x: And the drummer? And the drummer. And the drummer. Let me see, oh, we had, uh, Reed Happy. You ever, you ever heard him? We heard him. And, uh, you know. Mm-hm.

Who was a trombone player with Robo Show? Who was a trombone player? Oak Gasper. Not Oak. No, Oak's brother. What's his name? Victor. Yeah, Vic Gasper. He was a trombone player. Johnny, Johnny, Johnny, Johnny, Johnny, Johnny should play trombone with him too.
